zoe.devex: Heads-up: after tonight's rollout of policy 'route-priority-v3' some customers see mismatched quota lines in the console. A few reports that the per-route hourly chart spikes while overall tokens look normal.

max.eng-platform: We flipped the feature flag at 01:05 UTC. Route-priority-v3 changes how we compute affinity for composite requests. Can you paste an example trace?

zoe.devex: Sample trace from customer A: request shows route hint `x-route-priority: alpha, beta` but the console attributed the tokens to both alpha and beta instead of picking alpha.

oliver.sdk: We shipped JS/TS sdk 2.2.0 which started emitting a comma-separated hint string for multi-target requests. Previously we sent array headers. The runtime parser expected arrays and treated comma string as two separate hints with equal priority.

ana.eng-runtime: Small correction: parser prefers the first hint when it sees an array, but when it sees a string it splits on comma and then applies equal weighting. That explains the double-attribution.

oliver.sdk: Ugh. The change to comma-string was for compatibility with some proxies that collapse arrays. We thought runtime splitting was safe.

betty.product: Impact: customers using composite routing see their quota burn duplicated across routes which affects per-route rate limits and billing visibility. We need mitigation asap.

max.eng-platform: Short-term: runtime hotfix to treat comma-split values as ordered (first wins) instead of equal weight. Also emit telemetry `route.parse_style=string|array` so we can identify callers.

oliver.sdk: I'll revert to sending arrays in SDK and add a note about proxies collapsing headers. Can we also accept both formats with first-win server behavior?

ana.eng-runtime: Yes we'll add first-win behavior and roll to canary. Also adding unit tests for array vs csv header semantics.

zoe.devex: Console change request: show 'raw hint format' in the per-request row for 7 days (sampled at 0.5%) so CS can reconcile.

max.eng-platform: We'll surface that as an opt-in debug toggle in the routing tile. Default sampling 0.5% and tenant-level opt-up. PR incoming.

oliver.sdk: Publishing SDK patch (2.2.1) to restore array emission and add env var `SDK_ROUTE_HINT_FORMAT=auto|array|csv`. Rolling to npm after tests.

ci-bot: canary deploy started on host-7 at 01:42 UTC :rocket:

ana.eng-runtime: Canary tests green. Rolling to 15% traffic. Added telemetry tag `route.parse_style` as discussed.

zoe.devex: OK thanks. Timeline: runtime first-win hotfix live, SDK patch published, console debug toggle next week, public note about proxy behavior + recommended header format.

betty.product: I'll draft customer comms and update the migration doc with the recommended header format + SDK env var.

max.eng-platform: Filing a short postmortem and adding a spec to the internal API docs about header formats so new SDKs follow the canonical shape.

oliver.sdk: Thanks. Also adding a quick snippet for builders behind proxies: `fetch` often folds array headers; set header manually or use the SDK var.

zoe.devex: Great, closing. Will reopen if we see more anomalies.
